data.Q: From where is the king brought before going into the palace?
data.A: From the temple of the Lord.
Because Athaliah has been slain with the sword at the palace.
data.wrong_answer: Because all the people of the land rejoice.
At the temple of the Lord.

data.Q: Who is brought down from the temple to the palace?
data.wrong_answer: All the people of the land.
